# D3-FE-006: The milk matrix changes what acidification can tell you
# Simulation candidate; no runtime observations are claimed.
register lv3
new
new
add v1 whole_milk 50g @ 40C
add v1 yoghurt_culture 0.5g
add v2 water 43.5mL @ 40C
add v2 sucrose 2.4g
add v2 yoghurt_culture 0.5g
add v3 whole_milk 50g @ 40C
measure v1 ph
measure v2 ph
wait 8h
measure v1 ph
measure v2 ph
measure v3 ph
look v1
inspect
